name: Quarante de Roi
summary: Historical French four-player partnership point-trick game named for its 40-point four-Kings bonus.
rules_text: Quarante de Roi uses 32 cards ranking K Q J A 10 9 8 7. Four players form two teams of two opposite each other. Teams are set in a preliminary deal where whoever receives matching colour Kings partners. For each hand shuffle and deal 8 cards each anticlockwise and turn the last card as trump, which belongs to dealer. Before play a player holding 3 or 4 Jacks, Queens or Kings may have a clique. On playing to first trick he may announce the size and if contested the rank. Only the single highest clique counts, in order 3J <3Q <3K <4J <4Q <4K, scoring 6,8,10,13,20,40. Leader leads to a trick, others must follow suit if able else discard or trump. Highest trump or highest card of led suit wins trick. Card points in tricks plus clique points are totaled. Dealer rotates right and game is 150 points over several deals.
